signals.title: The French private equity firm Siparex has acquired a majority stake (65% according to BeBeez sources) in Modena-based ATK Sports from Progressio Sgr
signals.what_changed: Siparex has signed an agreement to acquire a majority stake in ATK Sports from Progressio SGR, with the stake reportedly amounting to 65% according to BeBeez sources. ATK Sports, a Modena-based company and leader in high-performance ski touring bindings, represents a clear example of Italian private equity activity in the sports and outdoor sector.
signals.what_changed_original: Siparex ha firmato l’acquisizione della maggioranza di ATK Sports da Progressio SGR, con una quota indicata al 65% secondo fonti BeBeez. ATK Sports, società modenese leader negli attacchi da sci alpinismo ad alte prestazioni, è una chiara operazione PE italiana nel settore sport/outdoor.

signals.title: Arcaplanet (Fressnaps-Cinven) shows no signs of slowing down. It has also acquired the 12 Animalstore locations.

signals.title: Consilium SGR acquires a minority stake in Twin Pack, a specialist in packaging machinery
signals.what_changed: Consilium SGR, through the Consilium Private Equity Fund IV, has acquired a minority stake in Twin Pack, a company based in Podenzano (Piacenza) that specializes in packaging machinery. Founder Luciano Gandini remains the majority shareholder. The transaction has been confirmed and involves an Italian SME.

Il fondatore Luciano Gandini resta azionista di maggioranza. L’operazione è confermata e riguarda una PMI italiana.
signals.title_original: Consilium sgr compra una minoranza in Twin Pack, specialista in macchine per il packaging

signals.title: Investindustrial and the Catelli family are strengthening Artsana with 258 mln euro through a capital increase and the conversion of a shareholder loan into equity
signals.what_changed: Artsana, a group based in Grandate (Como) that specializes in baby care products, is strengthening its capital base through a 258 million euro transaction consisting of a capital increase and the conversion of a shareholder loan into equity. The transaction involves Investindustrial and the Catelli family, shareholders of the Italian company.
signals.what_changed_original: Artsana, gruppo di Grandate (Como) attivo nei prodotti per la cura dei bambini, rafforza il patrimonio con una manovra da 258 milioni di euro tra aumento di capitale e conversione in equity del finanziamento soci. L’operazione coinvolge Investindustrial e la famiglia Catelli, azionisti della società italiana.
signals.title_original: Investindustrial e famiglia Catelli rafforzano Artsana con 258 mln euro tra aumento di capitale e conversione a equity del finanziamento soci

signals.title: BeBeez Awards Special – Namirial Triples Revenue in Five Years and Conquers Europe’s Digital Trust Market: CEO Max Pellegrini Wins Two Awards at the BeBeez Awards
signals.what_changed: A feature article on Namirial, a Bain Capital portfolio company, which has tripled its revenue from less than 50 million in 2020 to an expected 300 million in 2026. The Italian digital trust company has become a leading pan-European platform for digital trust services.
signals.what_changed_original: Articolo celebrativo su Namirial, partecipata di Bain Capital, che ha triplicato i ricavi da meno di 50 milioni nel 2020 a oltre 300 milioni attesi nel 2026. La società italiana di digital trust è diventata una piattaforma paneuropea leader nei servizi fiduciari digitali.
signals.title_original: Speciale BeBeez Awards – Namirial triplica i ricavi in cinque anni e conquista l’Europa del digital trust: doppio premio al ceo Max Pellegrini ai BeBeez Awards

signals.title: BeBeez Awards Special – Lutech Surpasses 1 Billion Euros in Revenue with 30 Acquisitions in Six Years: Giuseppe Di Franco Receives the Add-on Award at the BeBeez Awards
signals.what_changed: A feature article on Lutech, a portfolio company of One Equity Partners, which has surpassed 1 billion euros in revenue following more than 30 acquisitions over the past six years. The Italian ICT group has strengthened its international presence and expanded its offerings in artificial intelligence and software.
signals.what_changed_original: Articolo celebrativo su Lutech, società in portafoglio a One Equity Partners, che ha superato 1 miliardo di euro di ricavi dopo oltre 30 acquisizioni in sei anni. Il gruppo ICT italiano ha rafforzato la presenza internazionale e l’offerta su artificial intelligence e software.

signals.title: BeBeez Awards Special – Impresoft Quintuples Revenue in Six Years and Accelerates M&A Efforts: Alessandro Geraldi Receives the Business Growth Award at the BeBeez Awards
signals.what_changed: A feature article on Impresoft, a subsidiary of Clessidra SGR, which has increased its revenue fivefold to nearly 250 million euros in six years. signals.what_changed_original: Articolo celebrativo su Impresoft, partecipata di Clessidra SGR, che ha quintuplicato i ricavi fino a quasi 250 milioni di euro in sei anni. Il gruppo italiano software e servizi digitali ha completato 18 acquisizioni e accelera sulla crescita attraverso ulteriori operazioni di M&A.
signals.title_original: Speciale BeBeez Awards – Impresoft quintuplica i ricavi in sei anni e accelera sull’m&a: premio Crescita Business ad Alessandro Geraldi ai BeBeez Awards

signals.title: BeBeez Awards Special – TeamSystem Grows from 20,000 to 3 Million Customers and Focuses on AI: Readers’ Special Award Goes to Federico Leproux at the BeBeez Awards
signals.what_changed: A feature article on TeamSystem, a Silver Lake subsidiary, which has grown from 20,000 to 3 million customers. signals.title_original: Speciale BeBeez Awards – TeamSystem passa da 20 mila a 3 milioni di clienti e punta sull’AI: Premio Speciale Lettori a Federico Leproux ai BeBeez Awards

signals.title: Algebris Investments and a group of co-investors subscribe to a capital increase for a minority stake in Alfa Group
signals.what_changed: Algebris Investments, together with a group of institutional co-investors, is subscribing to a capital increase to acquire a minority stake in Alfa Group, an innovative Rome-based SME active in cybersecurity and digital fraud prevention. The transaction was announced and has strong ties to Italy.
signals.what_changed_original: Algebris Investments, con un gruppo di co-investitori istituzionali, sottoscrive un aumento di capitale per acquisire una quota di minoranza di Alfa Group, PMI innovativa romana attiva nella cybersecurity e nella prevenzione delle frodi digitali. Operazione annunciata, con forte connessione italiana.
signals.title_original: Algebris Investments e un gruppo di co-investitori sottoscrivono aumento di capitale per una minoranza di Alfa Group

signals.title: Arca Space Capital Takes Control of Rogelfrut. Entrepreneurs Reinvest 15%
signals.what_changed: Arca Space Capital, a fund managed by Arca Fondi SGR, announces the acquisition of a controlling stake in Rogelfrut, an Italian company engaged in the production and distribution of fresh and frozen fruit-based ingredients for ice cream, pastries, and the food and beverage industry. The founders are reinvesting 15%.

Gli imprenditori reinvestono per il 15%.
signals.title_original: Arca Space Capital al controllo di Rogelfrut. Gli imprenditori reinvestono per il 15%

signals.title: No Dig Alliance (Ambienta SGR) also acquires the Swedish company JS Drilling Solutions
signals.what_changed: No Dig Alliance, a subsidiary of Ambienta SGR since June 2025, has acquired the Swedish company JS Drilling Solutions AB, which specializes in the installation of underground pipelines and trenchless services for water and sewer networks. The financial terms of the deal were not disclosed. The transaction strengthens the group’s Nordic platform.
signals.what_changed_original: No Dig Alliance, controllata da Ambienta sgr dal giugno 2025, ha acquisito la svedese JS Drilling Solutions AB, attiva nell’installazione di condotte sotterranee e nei servizi trenchless per reti idriche e fognarie. I termini economici non sono stati resi noti. L’operazione rafforza la piattaforma nordica del gruppo.

signals.title: Carlyle sells a logistics facility in Mesero (Mi) to a company in the food import and distribution sector
